questions.question: Which planet is the smallest in our solar system?
questions.explanation: Mercury is the smallest planet in the solar system.
questions.evidence: NASA identifies Mercury as the smallest planet in the solar system.
choice_notes: NASA identifies Mercury as the smallest planet.
Neptune is much larger than Mercury.

questions.question: NASA reported Dragonfly’s first simulated flight on October 23, 2026. Where did the test take place?
questions.explanation: The test used flight-like avionics on a computer testbed at Johns Hopkins APL in Maryland.
questions.evidence: NASA describes a computer testbed at Johns Hopkins APL, rather than a flight on Titan.
choice_notes: NASA identifies a computer testbed in Maryland.
Titan was the simulated setting, not the actual test location.
The test was in a terrestrial laboratory, not Saturn orbit.
Dragonfly’s test was not conducted on the Moon.

questions.question: About how many Earth years does Neptune take to orbit the Sun?
questions.explanation: A year on Neptune lasts approximately 165 Earth years.
questions.evidence: NASA states that Neptune orbits the Sun in about 165 Earth years.
choice_notes: 84 years is closer to Uranus’s period.
29 years is closer to Saturn’s period.
12 years is closer to Jupiter’s period.
